## Checklist

- [ ] Discussed and agreed in an issue beforehand
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] New source files start with the SPDX license header (`MPL-2.0` for code, `CC-BY-4.0` for `docs/`)
- [ ] User-visible or protocol-visible changes are in `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased*
- [ ] The specification in `docs/` and test vectors in `testdata/` are updated if the protocol changed
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, or internal addresses
